thread:
maria (support): Heads-up — acme-inc just escalated: /v1/rerank returning 400 with 'invalid UTF-8' for some items in their batch. They say payload contains emojis and pasted CSVs from a legacy system.
kevin (eng-rerank): Can you paste the original request body (raw) or cURL? need to repro.
maria (support): here's a sanitized repro (keeps failing):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" \
  -d '{"query":"price list 💸","documents":["Item A\\u0000","Item B\\xFF"]}'
```
raj (customer-success): they hit it in production when importing CSV with embedded NULs. latency spiked then 400s.
sasha (devex): on the runtime side, bad bytes can cause JSON decoding to throw. we should either sanitize input or coerce to replace invalid sequences. can you attach the SDK lib and version they used?
maria (support): client uses node 2.4.1 (internal SDK). reproduced locally with the cURL above — server logs show: `json_decode error: invalid utf8 sequence at byte 12`.
kevin (eng-rerank): thanks. likely two issues: (1) our rerank endpoint expects valid UTF-8 and returns 400; (2) scoring code doesn't handle zero-length doc or truncated tokenization which can produce weird scores. can you run this python snippet to send raw bytes?
```python
import requests
b = b'{"query":"\\xf0\\x28\\x8c","documents":["A\\x00B"]}'
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer REDACTED','Content-Type':'application/json'}, data=b)
print(r.status_code, r.text)
```
maria (support): reproduced 400 + message 'invalid UTF-8 in request body'. customer also reported one run where all scores returned 1.0 then 0.0 next call.
kevin (eng-rerank): that behavior can happen if tokenizer fails and we fallback to similarity heuristic — bug. I'll open ENG-PI-2314. quick mitigation: support can advise customers to run simple sanitization: replace \u0000 and normalize to NFC and drop non-UTF8 bytes. example:
```js
// node sanitizer
const clean = s => Buffer.from(s, 'utf8').toString('utf8').replace(/\\u0000/g,'');
```
maria (support): passing that to customer. do we need a temporary proxy to auto-sanitize for dedicated customers?
sasha (devex): for Dedicated we can enable request sanitizer in the edge proxy. eng-infra should weigh perf cost. @kevin please coordinate.
kevin (eng-rerank): will do. also adding telemetry to log counts of invalid sequences per route. :eyes:
ingest-bot: incident-created ENG-PI-2314 by kevin — rerank UTF-8 handling + scoring fallback.
maria (support): thanks team, I'll update customer and mark P1 until we have a fix. :white_check_mark:
